meta.name: Queens
meta.description: The Sarkar empire was the only thing blocking Nilmoni Mishra from absolute power. His answer? A brutal wedding night massacre. Now, four grieving widows inherit a legacy of blood and enemies. Led by Meera, pregnant and fierce, they choose vengeance over tears. Blood will answer blood.

videos.title: Shaheb-Er Order
videos.overview: A wedding night ends in gunfire. Four Sarkar men die. Four widows survive, and a brutal new war begins.

videos.title: Haat-E Rawkter Daag
videos.overview: The grieving is over; the execution begins. Meera wipes her sindoor and demands blood for blood.

videos.title: Dhal-Tarowal
videos.overview: Shankar brings fire to their door. Meera calls Bhola as the widows stop hiding and strike back hard.

videos.title: Action Hobey
videos.overview: Midnight raid. Swords, machetes, and pure fury. The widows bleed the mighty empire for the first time.

videos.title: Khuchiye Ghaa Koro Na
videos.overview: Aditya is missing while Shankar hunts the hills. Meera races the clock before one wrong turn ends it all.

videos.title: Kono Meyechhele Nai
videos.overview: They abduct Ruchi and shoot Nana. Left with absolutely nothing to lose, these women are now lethal.

videos.title: Raja Bodlanor Somoy
videos.overview: Four grieving widows become four ruthless queens. The old empire falls as they rise to claim the throne.
